parsed.explanation: The write-up proves cancellation only when Xiang splits each of the n pieces of length 2d exactly once. It merely asserts that other distributions of the cuts give Liu at least as much, and explicitly says this still needs proof. More fundamentally, the construction targets (n+1)/(2n+1), which differs from the correct 2^n/(2^(n+1)-1) for n≥2. Establishing L3.3 therefore requires a different construction and an all-n argument covering every Xiang reply, not a local edit.
